name: services/mailclient/message_address_limit
description: Get the maximum number of recipient addresses allowed
brief_description: Get the maximum number of recipient addresses allowed

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Returns the dictionary with one key limit and one value — the current value of the recipient address limit used in methods: send_message, create_and_send_message and refresh_recipients. If this value is null, then there is no limit.
